title: GoDeep: Annotation-Free Open-Vocabulary 3D Scene Understanding via Language-Space Lifting
abstract: arXiv:2609.09082v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Open vocabulary 3D semantic segmentation methods typically lift CLIP features into 3D. This embeds points in a joint vision-language space known to behave like a bag-of-words on compositional tasks. Furthermore, even annotation free variants often require a large 3D training corpus and a dedicated 3D encoder per domain. Instead we use a vision-language model purely as a translator. It produces structured, entity-level descriptions of each posed image. These descriptions are grounded, projected, and aggregated directly in a general-purpose, language-only embedding space, with no 3D training corpus or encoder required. On ScanNet++, our pipeline is competitive with strong annotation free baselines trained on ScanNet. On a 5-building cultural heritage benchmark, raw scores initially favor a CLIP-based variant, but a single systematic vocabulary correction reverses this ranking. translated_title: GoDeep：通过语言空间提升实现免标注的开放词汇3D场景理解
translated_abstract: 开放词汇3D语义分割方法通常将CLIP特征提升到3D空间中，这会将点嵌入到一个联合视觉-语言空间中，而该空间在组合性任务上的表现已知类似于词袋模型。此外，即使是免标注的变体方法通常也需要大规模的3D训练语料库，并且每个领域都需要专用的3D编码器。与之相反，我们仅将视觉-语言模型用作翻译器，它对每张带位姿的图像生成结构化的、实体级别的描述。这些描述被接地、投影并直接聚合到一个通用的纯语言嵌入空间中，无需3D训练语料库或编码器。在ScanNet++数据集上，我们的流程与在ScanNet上训练的强大免标注基线方法相比具有竞争力。在一个由5栋建筑组成的文化遗产基准测试中，原始分数最初偏向于基于CLIP的变体，但一次系统性的词汇修正就逆转了这一排名，这一效应在第二次独立修正中得到了证实。
tldr: 该论文提出GoDeep方法，仅将视觉-语言模型作为翻译器生成实体级图像描述，并直接在纯语言嵌入空间中投影和聚合，无需3D训练语料库或专用编码器即可实现免标注的开放词汇3D场景理解。
en_tdlr: GoDeep uses a vision-language model purely as a translator to generate entity-level image descriptions that are grounded, projected, and aggregated directly in a language-only embedding space, achieving annotation-free open-vocabulary 3D scene understanding without requiring any 3D training corpus or encoder.
